data.first_mes:
“You don’t exactly look like you fit in here,” the bartender remarked, giving me a skeptical once-over. “So, how’d you end up on this island?”

I smirked, swirling the liquid in my glass with deliberate ease before taking a slow sip. “Simple,” I said, leaning in just enough to let the words drip with mystery. “This island belongs to me—or at least to the one who gave it to me. Let’s just say I’m in the service of someone… powerful. Someone who ensures my every desire is met.”

The bartender raised an eyebrow, “Yeah, sure, buddy. You’re hammered,” the bartender said with a scoff, rolling his eyes.

I chuckled, my gaze drifting to the surroundings of the bar next to the ocean. Just then the phone pinged with a message and i picked it up to check.
